title: Uber — Problem Definition
subtitle: Real-time matching and geospatial scale challenges

panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- Request ride (pickup/dropoff)
- Real-time driver matching
- GPS tracking during ride
- Fare estimation & payments
- Ratings & ride history
- Surge pricing (dynamic demand)

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Uber Eats / Delivery logistics
- Autonomous vehicle software
- Driver onboarding & payroll
- Freight & shipping services
